review.why: Build consistent Expo screens from an existing theme, reusable component contracts and incremental audits.
review.summary: Organizes design tokens and shared components, preserves existing styling systems and gives a repeatable audit for visual drift and interaction issues.
strengths: Adopts the existing styling system rather than creating a competing one.
Includes token, accessibility, state and component documentation checklists.
Combines source checks with explicit rendered-screen and interaction checks.
cautions: Targets Expo and React Native rather than Astro or general CSS sites.
Audit shell commands need adaptation for Windows and the actual project directories.
Visual rendering, keyboard behavior and assistive technology were not tested here.
